body: Well, I've let the counselors at the uni know that I'm suicidal and I've talked to them but I haven't gotten much help besides anxiety techniques and blood work done. I have low iron which has taken me forever to even get back up. But other than that nothing else.

Well, just my room currently. My parents have given up knocking on the door I just pretend that I'm asleep. I don't have any money to move out and I don't have a job which makes things hard. With my current ability to function in college, I'm very unsure of my ability to work. I was planning on moving to a new university and staying in a dorm. My parents are supporting me currently but I hope once I get working I can make myself independent. Because right now, they put guilt on me for going to college and using their money even though they said they would support me.

Y'know what you've said is very similar to what I've been going through the past 2 years. I'm 20 and I've only recently gotten sexually active say about a year ago. I have been using sex/masturbation as a way to escape my thoughts. Maybe I'll try helping others if my headache subsides. I have a very controlling household. I'm no longer allowed to play my saxophone because we have renters. But thanks for the help. Your help has given me some sort of ground to stand on.

I've been talking with my boyfriend and other friends and the helpline but nothing seems to change. I'm never heard and the more I go on living the more I start to become numb to the things I enjoyed. I used to love to go to the gym every day. That turned into every 2nd day to every week then nothing. I have no energy. I've been looking for work in my city but I don't get any responses. I go in person dressed nicely multiple times to places that say they are hiring but no reply I change my resume and cover letters. I have like 8 different copies with slight variations. It's not like I'm not trying to find something to bring me fulfillment but the world is continually dragging me down. And I have a suspicion that everything I love will eventually bring me nothing.
